brief.zh: 已知把封面搬到照片里的单应 H。把清楚的封面贴到照片里书的位置上：封面落到的地方是封面，其余还是照片。
brief.en: The homography H that carries the cover into the photo is given. Paste the crisp cover over the book in the photo: where the cover lands it is the cover, everywhere else still the photo.

hint.zh: <part-ref to="part:warp"></part-ref>能搬任何一张图。要知道封面落在哪，可以搬一张和封面一样大、全是 1 的图。
hint.en: <part-ref to="part:warp"></part-ref> can carry any picture. To know where the cover lands, carry a picture the size of the cover that is all 1.

after.zh: 变形加上一张同样变形的掩膜，就能把一张图合成进另一张：AR 贴图、全景拼接、换天空都是这一步。
after.en: A warp plus a mask warped the same way composites one picture into another: AR overlays, panorama stitching and sky replacement all take this step.

t.zh: 托盘里的<part-ref to="homography"></part-ref>：点对进去，出来 H 的 9 个数。这一关先不用它，H 直接给你。
t.en: The <part-ref to="homography"></part-ref> in the tray: pairs go in and the 9 numbers of H come out. This level does not need it yet: H is given.

t.zh: 新元件<part-ref to="part:warp"></part-ref>按 H 把一张图搬到另一张图上。
t.en: The new part <part-ref to="part:warp"></part-ref> carries a picture onto another by H.

t.zh: 这一关你要做的：把清楚的封面贴到照片里书的位置上。
t.en: Your task in this level: paste the crisp cover over the book in the photo.
